### TC.GraphicsPolygon

These are the properties of a filled polygon.

Extends: TC.GraphicsCommon

### color

Fill colour.

```text
TC.GraphicsColor
```

### vertices

Triangle strip, at least three points, as in LuaRendering.draw_polygon. Bounds use every vertex.

```text
(TC.GraphicsPoint)[]
```
